title: Lesson 14 - This Isn't What I Ordered

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That's me. Thanks. Let me check the order before I go.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I'm sorry to bother you, but there seems to be a mistake. This isn't what I ordered.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. What did you order?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I ordered one vegetable sandwich without cheese and one chicken sandwich. I got two chicken sandwiches.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: You're right. The label says one vegetable sandwich, no cheese.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I was also expecting a bottle of still water, but this is sparkling water.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: I see both errors on the receipt. We can replace the sandwich and the water.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Could you fix that, please? Aisha is waiting upstairs.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Of course. The sandwich will take about six minutes. The water will only take a moment.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Okay. How long will the whole order take?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Daniel? Here is the vegetable sandwich without cheese and one bottle of still water. Could you check them?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Vegetable, no cheese; still water. Yes, that's right. Thanks for helping me out.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: No problem. You fixed it quickly. I owe you one—well, not literally. It was your order to fix.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Fair point. Happy to help, anyway.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Thanks. Now I can take lunch upstairs before Aisha calls to ask where it is.
